Leafy_Glider_Wings.description: Emerging from the verdant expanse of the player's back, these ethereal wings are a marvel of nature, combining the resilience of ancient vines with the agility of a falcon, granting unparalleled mobility and the ability to glide effortlessly through even the densest foliage.

Giant_Petal_Wings.description: Emerging from the back of its hulking form, the Giant Petal Wings are a marvel of nature, vast and vibrant, capable of gliding through the air with grace and charm, enhancing the charisma and agility of their bearer while granting them the skills to captivate and navigate the skies with ease.

Thorny_Bramble_Gliders.description: Equipped with razor-sharp thorns and leathery, plant-based wings, Thorny Bramble Gliders are a fearsome sight in the twilight sky, their natural armor and enhanced strength making them formidable foes that can slash through enemies with ease while gracefully gliding through the air.

Bioluminescent_Fungal_Spore_Gliders.description: These ethereal, bioluminescent spores sprout delicate, translucent fungal wings that allow them to glide silently through the night, casting an eerie glow while releasing a cloud of toxic spores that can incapacitate the unwary.

Petrified_Wood_Heavy_Wings.description: Brimming with the eerie essence of the undead, these heavy wings are formed from petrified wood, granting a formidable natural armor but at the cost of agility, their cumbersome nature slowing the flight of their bearer while providing unparalleled resilience against physical attacks and knockbacks.

Woven_Vine_Glider_Wings.description: Emerging from the dense, twisted flora of the enchanted forests, the Woven Vine Glider Wings are a marvel of nature and magic, granting their bearer the strength and agility to soar through the air and scale sheer cliff faces with effortless grace, their limbs adorned with tendrils that intertwine to form a resilient, yet lightweight exoskeleton.

Broad_Kelp_Frond_Wings.description: The Broad Kelp Frond Wings are a pair of expansive, leaf-like appendages that unfurl from the back of aquatic plant entities, blending seamlessly with their underwater environment while granting them the grace to glide effortlessly through both water and air, enhancing their agility and evasiveness.

Pine_Needle_Gliding_Wings.description: Emerging from the sinewy branches that crisscross the entity's back, these delicate wings are a translucent blend of pine needles and thin, resilient membranes, granting unparalleled agility and the ability to glide effortlessly through the densest forests, their silent passage a testament to the grace of nature's enigmatic creatures.

Carnivorous_Pitcher_Lure_Wings.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of the forest, the Carnivorous Pitcher Lure Wings are a haunting marvel of nature, with iridescent wings that shimmer in the dim light, capable of emitting a noxious poison cloud and grappling unsuspecting prey with eerie precision.

Spongy_Mossy_Gliders.description: Spongy Mossy Gliders are eerie, plant-like creatures with translucent, spongy wings that allow them to glide silently through the night sky, their appendages coated in a layer of soft, mossy growth that enhances their ability to blend into their surroundings and avoid detection.
